stage_contract.purpose: Freeze a leakage-resistant session, label, split, and independent-holdout contract for authoritative MI48 data.
stage_contract.core_question: Can subject, session, recording, and label provenance be trusted sufficiently to create group-isolated roles and seal an independent holdout?
stage_contract.required_predecessor: A B6R-1 package with authoritative or approved MI48 identity, supported frame schema, full accounting, and usable group/label provenance.
allowed_inputs: read-only historical T-A5 split and holdout evidence
forbidden_inputs: promotion of the workspace archives to MI48 by directory name or resize target
synthetic fixtures represented as physical evidence
REAL_EVAL_DEVELOPMENT relabeled as an independent holdout
stage_contract.completion_gate: One group belongs to exactly one role, cross-role duplicate audit passes, every sample is accounted for, and an independent holdout is sealed.
stage_contract.next_stage_condition: B6R-2 completion gate PASS before any B6R-3 work.

retry_observations.model_input_axis_relationship: Observed source PNG is HxW 480x640. Historical thermal_prep.py resizes to PIL WxH 80x62, producing NumPy HxW 62x80 and then model input 62x80x1. This is a resize path, not evidence that the raw source is MI48 80x62 or 62x80.
retry_observations.label_provenance_assessment: Class tokens are observable, but no authoritative MI48 source contract, subject/session/recording identity, or SafeNest group provenance is available.

b6r1_checksum_diagnostic.interpretation: Checkout line-ending conversion explains the generated-artifact mismatch; it does not provide missing MI48 provenance or make the dataset gate pass.

failed_conditions: No owner-authorized or approved replacement MI48 source is materialized.
No eligible MI48 frame or supported MI48 schema family is available.
Subject, session, and recording identities are absent.
Observed class tokens lack authoritative MI48 and group provenance.
No pristine independent holdout is available.
The predecessor standalone validator still fails on raw checkout bytes, although the mismatch is diagnosed as CRLF conversion.

execution_decision.reason: A split would require inventing MI48 identity, group identity, or holdout independence.

unblock_requirements: Materialize an owner-authorized MI48 snapshot or explicitly approved replacement as read-only input.
Run a new B6R-1 revision and pass its standalone validator in the target checkout.
Provide trustworthy subject/session/recording and label provenance.
Provide a tuning-naive independent holdout or approve a new acquisition plan.
